name: food-express
description: Food Express — a multi-category delivery and shopping platform (groceries, fresh produce, daily essentials, electronics and restaurant food) built as plain HTML/CSS/vanilla JS with an optional Node/Express + MongoDB backend. Runs fully in a local demo mode with zero dependencies.

scripts.check: find shared js tools backend -name '*.js' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 node --check
scripts.verify: npm run build:pages && npm run check && npm run audit && npm test

notes.frontend: The storefront has no runtime dependencies — every page works by opening the generated HTML through tools/serve.js in local demo mode.
notes.backend: Dependencies above are only needed for backend/ (Express + Mongoose). Set MONGO_URI and JWT_SECRET in backend/.env before `npm run backend`.
notes.generated: Root *.html files are generated from src/pages/*.body.html by tools/build-pages.js — edit the fragments, then run `npm run build:pages`.
